services.name: Island Runner Cruises
services.desc: Come see what the hype is all about, join us aboard Crab Island Runner for a chartered trip to the popular sandbar in Destin, Florida. Xtreme H2O Sports’ Crab Island Runner is a multi-passenger U.S. Coast Guard certified charter boat for up to 27 passengers. The following items are offered to share on Crab Island trips with all the guests: Lily Pad - Water Floats - Water guns - Water toys Scoop up your seat or book a private option today. Fully inspected and insured, Crab Island Runner provides full shade over the walk-around deck and restroom for your comfort while on the water. Our Coast Guard licensed Captain and CPR certified mate guarantee to keep you safe while having a great time.
